quarterly_data.quarter: Renesas press release: Renesas Expands GaN Portfolio with First Low-Voltage GaN (10-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Renesas launched its first family of 100V enhancement-mode (E-mode) GaN discrete power transistors (RTP100E005G1FL, RTP100E2P6G1FL, RTP100E1P8G1FL-DSC, RTP100E1P2G1FL-DSC) for AI data centers (48V bus and 800 VDC power architectures), humanoid robotics, factory automation, motor drives, power tools and solar microinverters, available now with evaluation boards. The company claims industry-leading figure-of-merit: up to 35% lower hard-switching FOM and up to 63% lower soft-switching FOM than comparable GaN devices; RDS(on) range 5 mOhm-1.2 mOhm in MOSFET-compatible packages with bottom- and dual-side cooling; at system level up to 40-70% lower switching losses and up to twice the power density. They can be paired with Renesas' 6 kW 800V-to-48V DCX LLC reference design.
quarterly_data.figure: 100V E-mode GaN FETs; up to 35% lower hard-switching FOM; RDS(on) 5 mOhm-1.2 mOhm; available now
